title: Click 2000W Upright Desktop Fan Heater $10 @ Bunnings Warehouse
body:
Deal: Click 2000W Upright Desktop Fan Heater $10 @ Bunnings Warehouse

[djkelly69] How's the noise level on this (my use would be in an office)?
[mrvaluepack] They all sound the same, like other fan heaters of similar size.
[Juniormin] it's quite noticable if you are gonna use it in a quiet office, but once again, depends how much action is in your office
[TwoToasted] IMO not worth for the cost in elec compared to using an oil heater. Will kick out some heat for $10, but will cost more in electricity..
[mrvaluepack] Depends on the usage. Unless its a heat pump, all other electric heaters have the same efficiency.
[placard] Oil heaters and fan heaters consume the same electricity for the same heat output. Benefit of fan heaters is instant heat and oil heaters silent operation. No free or extra heat with oil heaters, they take some time to initially heat the oil and this is given off later when turned off.
Fan heaters great for small rooms and short use. Otherwise they'll chew power. Best way is reverse cycle air conditioning that consumes 20-30% power for the same heat output.
[Grok] The opposite is true. There is no magic sauce with an electric oil heater. They both do the same thing except one is faster.
The fan heater puts out pure heat with minimal losses and you get the heat straight away. You can point it at yourself as well if you want.
The Oil heater has to heat up the entire device, takes ages so you have plan ahead.
The fan heater is a bit noisey though.
[MrZ] These used to be sold as "Mistral". Why did they change the name?
[placard] Same Chinese factory and just branded as different names.
[mrvaluepack] there have been many over the years, goldair, mistral, kambrook, sunbeam, AWA ..
[mrvaluepack] Congrats with your modern hebel and foam home.
[Spendmore] Some have solar and battery and dont care.
[DoctorCalculon] before dust or moisture destroys them.
Mostly the dust which burns up in the hot filament.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] it's a DESKTOP fan heater guys. it's small only 20x20cm.
[mrvaluepack] they should remove the desktop name, this is like any other typical vintage fan heater.
the pure desktop ones are usually only 600 watts
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] but it's small. that's the point I wanted to make.
not saying it's bad deal it's only $10. but just so users are aware it's a small model.
[mrvaluepack] whats the average size of the vintage ones? maybe 3cm larger?
same wattage though, that means same heat output.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] @mrvaluepack: I don't know what is vintage. the one i have roughly 30x30.
if the fan is bigger usually also quieter.
[MrZ] Argh annoyed - I just bought 2 of these for $15 each back in April.
[Mild October] At least you enjoyed them for 4 months with $10.
[King Tightarse] They all do when new. These days the smell often doesn't really level out it seems.
Perhaps whatever fore retardants they use? Anyway it usually makes me not want to use them
[incipient] With the quality of the handful of Click branded items I have bought - I'm surprised they're not marketing this as a whole-home heater.
[ratmanuwu] nearest bunnings that has it in stock is 30km away :(
$12 shipping tho.. might be worth it when cheapest on amazon is $30.
